From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Supplier identity & payments bundle request — Prime Tools

Hi Tara / Prime Tools team,

Welcome — were starting your vendor activation for Redwood. To get your account live and enable PO issuance + payments, can you please send the items below as a single bundle (PDFs preferred) by EOD Thursday, Aug 5? If anything is not applicable, mark it so we can proceed.

Required:
- Legal entity name exactly as registered
- Registered business address (street, city, state, postal code)
- Tax ID: W-9 (US) or W-8 form (non-US) attached
- Remit-to details: remit-to email and physical remit address
- Bank payment instructions: ACH routing + account number (or wire instructions)
- Bank proof: voided check or bank letter on bank letterhead
- Invoice contact and preferred invoice format (PDF/CSV)
- PO acceptance method (email address or trading partner/EDI details)

Optional but helpful:
- VAT/GBR registration number (if applicable)
- Sample invoice (to verify fields)
- Standard payment terms (Net30/Net45) and early-pay discounts if any

Well use these to complete our buyer intake worksheet and create the vendor record. After we receive the bundle well verify the bank proof and then send a confirmation that the vendor is active and the first PO will be routed to the billing address you provide.

If youd rather upload securely, you can use the folder link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-prime-onboard (preferred).

Thanks — short next steps: you send bundle -> Finance verifies -> we create vendor -> we issue first PO.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0197

--

Thanks Tara — received and really helpful. A couple of clarifying items before we kick off verification: 

1) For the ACH file, can you confirm the account holder name exactly matches the legal entity (Prime Tools, Inc.)? Our bank requires an exact match for automated verification.
2) For wire transfers, do you use an intermediary bank? If so, please include intermediary routing/Swift details on the ACH/Wire form.
3) Well need a copy of the sample invoice that includes your billing contact and PO field (if the sample you attached doesnt show the PO location please send one that does).

If you can send the short answers above (or a revised ACH/Wire form that includes intermediary details and account-holder name) well move to the bank verification step immediately and expect vendor creation within 48 hours of verification.

Hi Tara — Marissa here in Finance Ops. Thanks for sending everything so quickly. A few notes from our side: 

- We can proceed once Jonas confirms the ACH account-holder name matches the legal entity and we have the intermediary bank details if applicable.
- Once verification is complete well create the vendor record in our AP system and provide your vendor ID.
- Redwood issues POs from our procurement system; PO numbers will be in the format RWD-##### and will be emailed to billing@primetools.co. Please ensure invoices include that PO on the first line so they match automatically.
- For tax classification: Prime Tools appears to be a US corporation; well mark you as a 1099-non-reportable vendor unless we hear otherwise. If you expect Form 1099 reporting please confirm.

Ill pick this up as soon as we get the ACH confirmation. If everything verifies well target vendor activation by EOD Tuesday, Aug 3.

Thanks — Marissa Cole
